summary: First full test run of WorkRate (FastAPI+SQLite backend, Vite/React19 frontend). Backend: existing 31 pytest tests pass, plus a new 16-test public-URL suite (15/16 pass). Frontend: tested dashboard (headline, measure toggles, flow buckets, metric drills), global filters (presets, custom dates, project/model/harness popovers, URL persistence across nav and reload), ledger filters/search/row->sheet, create task (validation + criteria), task sheet (3 switches + outcome rules, measurements save, history, criteria, evidence, deliverables, usage linking + computed panel), ccusage import (4 new/1 invalid/unpriced warning -> commit -> 4 duplicates + commit disabled -> history), CSV import w/ mapping, records-tab linking, subscriptions add/validate/delete, manual entry, efficiency (hero, scatter click->task, cell drill), compare (model keys, mix-adjusted table, harness/project/period A/B), drift (labels, harness confounders, min-n), community (banner, shared/excluded, switch, publish disabled, download), reports (weekly, week change, all export links 200), settings (reprice glm-4.6 toast, add project, demo reset with confirm, theme toggle). Found 1 critical bug (fixed: create task with criteria failed), 2 high bugs (week-bar drill dead; CSV mapping UI unreachable for unrecognised headers) and several minor issues. Demo data reset via POST /api/v1/demo/reset at the end.

critical.issue: When CSV headers are not auto-recognised (e.g. 'when,llm,in,out,usd'), importers.parse_csv raises ParseError -> 422 'A date column is required...'. No csv.headers/mapping is returned, so the frontend mapping UI (csv-mapping, rendered only when preview.csv.headers exists) never appears; the user cannot map columns from the UI. The review's CSV flow (map date->when ...) is impossible as written. Fix: when date is unmapped return 200 with csv {headers, mapping} and rows marked invalid / file_warning instead of raising (or have the frontend render mapping from a 422 payload).

minor.issue: Returns 0 when all linked usage is unpriced (list endpoint returns null). TaskSheet shows 'API-EQUIVALENT $0.00 · 1 unpriced' which contradicts the 'never guessed' rule. Return None when no priced records.

tasks_shared=0, tasks_suppressed=396 even with all synthetic data included (model x harness x category x difficulty x week buckets never reach k=5), so the preview never demonstrates a shared bucket and the include-synthetic toggle has no visible effect on counts.
Unknown fields silently ignored with 200 (e.g. 'reference_minutes' instead of 'reference_human_minutes'). Consider model_config extra='forbid'.
create_task uses datetime.now() while update_task uses utcnow() for state timestamps -> time_to_accept skew if server TZ != UTC.
Default limit=500 silently truncates; dashboard drill/ledger will under-count once tasks > 500.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a week bar does nothing. drillWeek reads e.activePayload, which Recharts 3.x (3.6.0) no longer passes to ComposedChart onClick. Use e.activeIndex / e.activeLabel to look up data[idx] (or attach onClick to each <Bar>).

FIXED BY TESTER: creating a task with any acceptance criterion failed with '0: Input should be a valid dictionary...' because criteria were sent as strings; backend expects [{text}]. Added .transform(a => a.map(text => ({text}))) to taskCreateSchema.criteria. Verified creation now works.

integration_issues.issue: Preview shows only an error toast; mapping selects (csv-map-*) never render (see backend issue). Works only when a 'date'-like header is auto-detected.

design_issues.screen: Global filter bar / Manual entry / Subscriptions / Reports week
issues: Native browser date pickers (input type=date, mm/dd/yyyy) used instead of a styled shadcn Calendar/Popover; inconsistent with the rest of the UI.
Recharts 3 accessibility layer draws a white focus rectangle around the plot area after click (visible outline). Set accessibilityLayer={false} or style outline.
Disabled 'Publish' button still uses bright primary styling and looks enabled.
'SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA' badge yellow text on cream background has low contrast.
Last x-axis tick label is clipped ('Oct 1' instead of 'Oct 12').
Filter bar end-date input overflows viewport (scrollWidth 394); ledger table titles truncated to 3 chars. Low priority for a desktop analytics tool.
Validation errors show raw field paths (e.g. 'project_id: Choose a project', 'title: ...'); stale error persists until next submit.
Filename label keeps 'sample-ccusage-daily.json' after pasting other content; a later pasted CSV reuses the previous csv mapping state (mapping only reset on file upload).

action_items: Fix dashboard week-bar drill for Recharts 3: replace e.activePayload with data[e.activeIndex] (Dashboard.tsx line ~40)
Make CSV preview return headers+mapping (200 with invalid rows/file_warning) when date column cannot be auto-mapped so the mapping UI can render; reset mapping when content changes
Return null (not 0) for computed.api_equiv_cost when no linked record has a known price
Review community contribution bucketing so synthetic data yields at least some k>=5 buckets (e.g. drop week or use month) or explain in UI

Optional: replace native date inputs with shadcn calendar; tone down disabled Publish button; fix light-theme synthetic badge contrast; set extra='forbid' on input schemas; use consistent UTC timestamps in create_task
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.tsx drillWeek depends on removed Recharts 2 API (activePayload) - only usage in codebase
lib/schemas.ts taskCreateSchema criteria shape mismatched backend TaskIn.criteria: list[CriterionIn] (fixed)
importers.parse_csv raises instead of returning headers when date unmapped; ImportWizard only renders mapping from successful preview
api._detail computed.api_equiv_cost sums known prices only and yields 0 for all-unknown
Pydantic input models accept unknown fields silently
frontend sampleCcusage builds dates with local-midnight Date then toISOString (UTC) - dates shift one day in UTC+ timezones

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (2 of ~25 flows broken after tester fix: week-bar drill, CSV mapping for unknown headers)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ tasks/usage/imports/subscriptions during testing; all wiped with POST /api/v1/demo/reset at the end (410 tasks / 663 usage restored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -q -n 0` (47 tests; test_csv_unmapped_preview_returns_headers documents the CSV mapping bug and should pass once fixed). Drift response uses group['overall'] for the label (group['label'] is the display name). Task reference field is reference_human_minutes. Selects are native <select> (use select_option). Switches expose aria-checked. Retest: week-bar click on value-chart opens drill-sheet; CSV 'when,llm,in,out,usd' shows csv-mapping; task computed API-eq for glm-4.6 tasks shows '—'. Reset demo data at end via POST /api/v1/demo/reset.
rca of the issue: 1) Create-task-with-criteria: frontend zod schema produced string[] while backend expects list[{text, met}] -> FastAPI 422 'Input should be a valid dictionary' surfaced in new-task-error. Fixed in schemas.ts. 2) Week drill: Recharts 3 changed chart mouse handler payload (MouseHandlerDataParam: activeIndex/activeLabel, no activePayload) so drillWeek returns early. Repro: click any bar on '/' -> no drill-sheet. 3) CSV mapping: parse_csv raises ParseError before returning headers; UI onError clears preview, mapping UI guarded by preview.csv.headers. Repro: paste 'when,llm,in,out,usd\n2026-10-10,glm-4.6,100,50,0.02', format CSV, Preview -> only toast.
